cases.name: expired-pin-repinned-from-24h-history
cases.description: The purchase-item pin expired at 06:00; the last 24h hold 20 reachable winners (gpt-5.4 x15, gpt-5-mini x5; the two claude winners are unreachable), so the 24h window is used.

cases.name: valid-pin-kept
cases.description: A pin that expires after now is kept as is.

cases.name: few-events-use-7d-window
cases.description: summarize has one reachable winner in the last 24h (< 20), so the 7-day window decides: gpt-5-mini x5 over gpt-5.4-mini x1.

cases.name: unknown-process-has-no-history
cases.description: No events for the process: action none (the wrapper routes in-path and pins the first call).

cases.name: pin-valid-exactly-at-expiry-is-expired
cases.description: now == expires_at is not before it: the pin is expired and history is consulted.

cases.name: tie-breaks-by-model-id
cases.description: Equal counts pin the lexicographically smaller id.

expected.reason: most frequent winner over 7d (tie broken by model id)

cases.name: events-outside-7d-ignored
cases.description: History older than 7 days never counts.

cases.name: first-call-pin
cases.description: The pin a process gets from its very first in-path route.

cases.name: tie-breaks-by-benchmark-score
cases.description: TS-295: a 3-3 tie over 7d between MiMo (benchmark score 0.51, $1.13/1M) and GLM-5.3 Flash (0.75, $0.33/1M). The higher catalog benchmark score wins the tie, never the list order; the server's summary pin_candidate uses the same rule.

expected.reason: most frequent winner over 7d (tie broken by benchmark score)

cases.name: tie-same-score-breaks-by-price
cases.description: Equal counts and equal benchmark scores: the lower blended price wins.

expected.reason: most frequent winner over 7d (tie broken by price)

cases.name: tie-unknown-score-sorts-last
cases.description: A model the catalog has no benchmark score for loses a tie to one it has a score for, whatever the ids.

expected.reason: most frequent winner over 7d (tie broken by benchmark score)

cases.name: more-wins-beat-a-better-score
cases.description: The tie-break never overrides the count: 3 wins beat 2 wins of a model with a higher score and a lower price.

cases.name: tie-with-starter-catalog-facts
cases.description: `models: "starter"` = model_facts() of the starter catalog (quality = mean clipped normalized benchmark score, 4 dp; price = blended USD per 1M, 6 dp). openai/gpt-5.4-mini and x-ai/grok-4 tie 2-2; gpt-5.4-mini has the higher catalog benchmark score.

expected.reason: most frequent winner over 7d (tie broken by benchmark score)

cases.name: starter-catalog-model-facts
cases.description: model_facts() of the starter catalog for a few ids: the tie-break inputs, defined exactly as the server's GET /v1/monitor/models quality and blended_price_usd_per_m.

cases.name: server-pin-wins-over-valid-local-pin
cases.description: TS-307: the dashboard pins summarize to gpt-5-mini (owner, version 3); the valid local pin of another model is replaced and the server's model is sent.

cases.name: server-winner-pin-keeps-its-expiry
cases.description: A winner pin from the server carries expires_at; the local entry takes it and the server window.

cases.name: server-pin-already-stored-no-write
cases.description: The local entry already equals the server pin: no pins.json write (no write per call).

cases.name: server-pin-used-when-env-sets-stable
cases.description: TRYAII_MONITOR_MODE=stable and the remote entry is stable with a pin: the server pin is still used.

cases.name: unpin-remote-off-removes-local-pin
cases.description: Unpin on the dashboard saves mode off: the next call of the process deletes its pins.json entry; other entries stay.

cases.name: unpin-from-store
cases.description: Removal over the shop store: checkout is set to dynamic remotely; purchase item stays.

cases.name: env-mode-off-does-not-remove
cases.description: The env overrides the mode (off): a local override never deletes a pin.

cases.name: remote-off-without-local-pin
cases.description: Nothing to remove: no write.

cases.name: version-bump-invalidates-local-pin
cases.description: Stable chosen after an unpin, no winner yet (pin null, pin_version 4): the valid local pin of version 3 is dropped and re-evaluated; the new pin stores version 4.

cases.name: version-match-keeps-local-pin
cases.description: pin_version equals the local version and the pin is valid: kept.

cases.name: v17-remote-without-pin-version-keeps-today
cases.description: A v1.7 server sends no pin_version and no pin: no compare, the valid local pin is kept (the 0.8.2 behaviour).

cases.name: old-pins-json-without-version-counts-as-0
cases.description: A pins.json from before v1.8 (no version) matches pin_version 0.

cases.name: old-pins-json-without-version-dropped-on-bump
cases.description: A pins.json without version (0) against pin_version 1: dropped, re-evaluated.

cases.name: no-remote-config-expired-pin-evaluates
cases.description: No remote.json: the expired pin goes to evaluate_pin, the new pin stores version 0, nothing written yet.

cases.name: owner-pin-without-expiry-stays-valid
cases.description: A stored owner pin (expires_at null) holds while nothing newer arrives (here: no remote.json).

cases.name: default-mode-stable-no-process-entry
cases.description: Stable comes from default_mode (no process entry, so no pin_version): no compare, the valid local pin is kept.

cases.name: app-name-mismatch-warns
cases.description: TS-308: wrap(app="summarizer") with a key of the app "shop": the one warning line.
cases.expected: tryaii monitor: app="summarizer" uploads to app "shop" (the app of TRYAII_API_KEY). To use a separate app, run: tryaii apps create summarizer and use its key.

cases.name: app-name-match-is-quiet
cases.description: Same name: no warning.

cases.name: app-name-exact-compare
cases.description: Exact string compare: "Shop" differs from "shop".
cases.expected: tryaii monitor: app="shop" uploads to app "Shop" (the app of TRYAII_API_KEY). To use a separate app, run: tryaii apps create shop and use its key.

cases.name: app-name-absent-v17-is-quiet
cases.description: A v1.7 server sends no app_name: no warning.
